#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add one final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx."""
import os
import re
import sys
import zipfile
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"
DEFAULT_NAME = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"

NS_R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
REL_SLIDE = NS_R + "/slide"
REL_LAYOUT = NS_R + "/slideLayout"
NS_REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"


def locate(name):
    if os.path.isfile(name):
        return name
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(os.curdir):
        if name in files:
            return os.path.join(root, name)
    return None


def verify(src, text):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as zin:
        names = zin.namelist()
        pres_rels = zin.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
        nums = []
        for n in names:
            m = re.fullmatch(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml", n)
            if m:
                nums.append(int(m.group(1)))
        if not nums:
            sys.exit("error: no slides found")
        last_name = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % max(nums)
        last_body = zin.read(last_name).decode("utf-8")
    if text not in last_body:
        sys.exit("error: verification failed - text not found in " + last_name)
    if last_name.replace("ppt/", "") not in pres_rels:
        sys.exit("error: verification failed - slide missing from presentation.xml.rels")
    print("OK: %s is the final slide and contains %r" % (last_name, text))


def edit_with_pptx(src):
    from pptx import Presentation
    from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
    from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
    prs = Presentation(src)
    layout = None
    for l in prs.slide_layouts:
        if not l.placeholders:
            layout = l
            break
    if layout is None:
        layout = prs.slide_layouts[-1]
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(2.75), Inches(8), Inches(1.1))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = TEXT
    run.font.size = Pt(40)
    run.font.bold = True
    prs.save(src)


def edit_raw(src):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as zin:
        entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}

    nums = []
    for n in entries:
        m = re.fullmatch(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml", n)
        if m:
            nums.append(int(m.group(1)))
    if not nums:
        sys.exit("error: no slides found in presentation")
    last = max(nums)
    nxt = last + 1
    slide_name = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % nxt
    slide_rels_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % nxt

    layout_target = None
    for n in range(last, 0, -1):
        rels_src = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % n
        if rels_src not in entries:
            continue
        text = entries[rels_src].decode("utf-8")
        m = re.search(
            r'<Relationship[^>]*Type="[^"]*slideLayout"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', text
        )
        if m:
            layout_target = m.group(1)
            break
    if not layout_target:
        sys.exit("error: could not find a slideLayout relationship")

    pres = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    m = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*cx="(\d+)"[^>]*cy="(\d+)"', pres)
    cx, cy = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (12192000, 6858000)

    offx, offy = int(cx * 0.1), int(cy * 0.42)
    extcx, extcy = int(cx * 0.8), int(cy * 0.16)

    slide_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">\n'
        '  <p:cSld>\n'
        '    <p:spTree>\n'
        '      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        '        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n'
        '        <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '        <a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '        </a:xfrm>\n'
        '      </p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:sp>\n'
        '        <p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouTextBox"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>\n'
        '          <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '        </p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:spPr>\n'
        '          <a:xfrm>\n'
        '            <a:off x="%d" y="%d"/>\n'
        '            <a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/>\n'
        '          </a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>\n'
        '          <a:noFill/>\n'
        '        </p:spPr>\n'
        '        <p:txBody>\n'
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" rtlCol="0"><a:spAutoFit/></a:bodyPr>\n'
        '          <a:lstStyle/>\n'
        '          <a:p>\n'
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        '            <a:r>\n'
        '              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1"/>\n'
        '              <a:t>%s</a:t>\n'
        '            </a:r>\n'
        '          </a:p>\n'
        '        </p:txBody>\n'
        '      </p:sp>\n'
        '    </p:spTree>\n'
        '  </p:cSld>\n'
        '  <p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '</p:sld>\n'
    ) % (offx, offy, extcx, extcy, escape(TEXT))

    new_slide_rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="%s">\n'
        '  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>\n'
        '</Relationships>\n'
    ) % (NS_REL, REL_LAYOUT, layout_target)

    rels = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode("utf-8")
    max_rid = max(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels))
    r_id = "rId%d" % (max_rid + 1)
    rel_entry = (
        '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="slides/slide%d.xml"/>'
        % (r_id, REL_SLIDE, nxt)
    )
    if "</Relationships>" not in rels:
        sys.exit("error: presentation.xml.rels malformed")
    rels = rels.replace("</Relationships>", rel_entry + "</Relationships>")

    ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', pres)]
    if not ids:
        sys.exit("error: no sldId entries in presentation.xml")
    new_sld_id = max(ids) + 1
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" not in pres:
        sys.exit("error: presentation.xml malformed (sldIdLst)")
    pres = pres.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>",
        '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="%s"/>' % (new_sld_id, r_id) + "</p:sldIdLst>",
    )

    ct_name = None
    for n in entries:
        if n.lower() == "[content_types].xml":
            ct_name = n
            break
    if not ct_name:
        sys.exit("error: [Content_Types].xml not found")
    ct = entries[ct_name].decode("utf-8")
    override = (
        '<Override PartName="/%s" '
        'ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
        % slide_name
    )
    if "</Types>" not in ct:
        sys.exit("error: [Content_Types].xml malformed")
    ct = ct.replace("</Types>", override + "</Types>")

    entries[slide_name] = slide_xml.encode("utf-8")
    entries[slide_rels_name] = new_slide_rels.encode("utf-8")
    entries["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres.encode("utf-8")
    entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = rels.encode("utf-8")
    entries[ct_name] = ct.encode("utf-8")

    tmp = src + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for n, data in entries.items():
            zout.writestr(n, data)
    os.replace(tmp, src)


def main():
    src = locate(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT_NAME)
    if not src:
        sys.exit("error: %s not found" % DEFAULT_NAME)
    try:
        edit_with_pptx(src)
    except ImportError:
        edit_raw(src)
    verify(src, TEXT)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
